notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json), which wowsims models as one package for all three specs. That preset's Shadow Bolt was a stale rank (25307 cast at rank 9; the build's current top rank for 25307 is 10) -- fixed here. It kept Amplify Curse as a prepull (buffs the next curse) which Affliction alone talents into, so it stays; Demonic Sacrifice was dropped since sacrificing the pet is a Demonology-tree talent Affliction does not have. Immolate was dropped as a maintained DoT (Destruction's signature, not Affliction's) in favor of Bane of Agony and Corruption, and Wrack (1316697) is added as a third maintained DoT -- Forever's own tier 6 Affliction capstone, a 6 second instant DoT the base wowsims/classic Affliction tree does not have. Fix round 1 (superseded): Wrack was reported inert here because sim/warlock had no spell file for it yet. Rotation-accuracy program (2026-09-28): sim/warlock/wrack.go now registers Wrack for real (talent-gated on warlock.Talents.Wrack, RequiredLevel 40) -- the line below is no longer inert, and since 70755's Wrack buff (sim-accuracy round 15) it is the filler and the spec's largest damage source, ahead of every DoT, with Shadow Bolt cast only before 40. The line's own note is corrected to match. Confirmed clean by the fix-round-1 review: Bane of Agony (11713) is exactly the spell id the engine's curse registration (sim/warlock/curses.go, function name getCurseOfAgonyBaseConfig notwithstanding) uses, and is fully castable; the separate 'Curse of Agony' spellconst entries (18671/1233077) are unrelated tuning data referenced nowhere in the engine, so no change was needed there. Rotation-accuracy audit, engine numbers (2026-09-28): Corruption's and Bane of Agony's per-tick base damage in sim/warlock (corruption.go, curses.go) carried classic tooltip values roughly double spellconst/warlock.json's own flat per-rank amount; fixed in the fork with a regression test each (commit 34803746d), which is why this spec's DPS dropped in this round's golden refresh -- the cast set and priority order are unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 62 percent of top casts) alongside Life Tap on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Rotation search (2026-10-06, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Corruption now leads Bane of Agony, Wrack is recast in its last second instead of after it drops, Immolate joins as a fourth DoT ahead of Shadow Bolt, and the wand gate moved from 20 to 40 percent mana; about +5.6 percent in that run. Rotation search (2026-10-07, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Bane of Doom (603) replaces Bane of Agony as the maintained curse after the engine took Doom's damage from the learnable client row (1742, coefficient 4.0): about +1.6 percent in this spec's run (a fight shorter than a minute would not pay Doom's single hit), beyond the combined error; Curse of the Elements measured lower than Agony. Bane of Doom (2026-10-07): the Doom line replaced Bane of Agony once Bane of Doom read client row 603 (1742 at coefficient 4.0) and carried spell power; the Doom-versus-Agony and Curse of the Elements comparisons are in design/reviews/2026-10-07-warlock-ua-coe.md. Immolate's recast moved from the moment it lapses to its last 3 seconds on 2026-10-08, when the rotation search measured the earlier recast beyond error. Theorycraft audit fix (2026-10-31, design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/casters.md W1, W2): the build took Siphon Life but the rotation never cast it, so Siphon Life is now kept up after Wrack, and Bane of Agony replaces Bane of Doom (Wrack's bonus to the warlock's other Shadow DoTs and periodic crits favour the ticking curse); together about +4 percent in that run. The wand line rarely fires now that a wand shot can no longer start inside a GCD. Sim-accuracy round 2 (2026-11-01): Wrack is a 6 second channel in Forever (client SpellMisc Attributes_1 0x4004, the Drain Life and Mind Flay bits; Wowhead's Forever tooltip reads "Channeled (6 sec cast)"), and its vulnerability covers only this warlock's Corruption and Bane of Agony (aura 271 on class mask 0x402). As a channel it dealt well under Shadow Bolt's damage per second of casting, and a Wrack filler measured below a Shadow Bolt filler, so the Wrack line is gone (client 1.60.1.70755 raised Wrack's base damage and spell power scaling, and Shadow Bolt still does more per second of casting); the engine fork models the channel from lane/r2-warlock. Sim-accuracy round 7 (2026-11-02): the potion line is gone. It required the execute phase as well as low mana, so it held the Major Mana Potion to the last 35% of the fight and a 3-minute fight drank one instead of two; without the line the engine drinks it on each cooldown when mana allows, as every other caster's rotation does, which measured about 1 percent higher.

engineering_notes.5: Wrack is live (sim/warlock/wrack.go, talent-gated, RequiredLevel 40). Since round 15 it is the filler from 40 and the spec's largest damage source; Shadow Bolt is cast only before 40, so Nightfall left the leveling build in round 17. The 10 Nov hotfix cut Wrack 30% and made it run Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony twice as fast while channelled, with Soul Siphon counting only those three: the 60 rotation drops Bane of Doom for Agony and recasts the three under 3 s (sim-accuracy 2026-11-11).

priorityList.notes: Life Tap below 10% mana. Each tap turns health, plus a point for every point of Spirit, into mana; a Healthstone or a healer covers the health.

Curse of the Elements when it is not already on the target (one per target, from any warlock). Curses and banes have separate slots, so it sits beside your bane for five minutes; two copies do not stack, so leave it to whoever holds it.

Corruption when it has fallen off or has under 3 seconds left. Instant with Improved Corruption. Wrack runs its clock twice as fast, so put a fresh one up before the next channel instead of letting it drop in the middle of one.
Amplify Curse right before each Bane of Agony whenever it is ready. It makes that Agony 50% stronger and costs no global.

Bane of Agony all fight, recast when it has fallen off or has under 3 seconds left. It is one of the three DoTs Wrack speeds up and Soul Siphon counts, so it beats Bane of Doom at 60, and Amplify Curse makes it 50% stronger whenever that is ready.
Siphon Life when it has fallen off or has under 3 seconds left. Shadow damage that heals you, and the third DoT for Soul Siphon.

Immolate with 3 seconds or less left on it. It lands a moment before the old one ends, and the fresh hit is worth the last tick. The raid build sacrifices the Imp and drops it: without Bane it is a 2 second Fire cast that Burning Shadow does nothing for, and Wrack does more in that time.

Raid build, from 34: Shadow Bolt the moment Nightfall gives you a Shadow Trance, ahead of your next Wrack from 40. It is instant, and at 60 each crit puts up Improved Shadow Bolt, so your Wrack and Shadow DoTs take 20% more for 12 seconds.
Wrack with your DoTs up. While you channel it, your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast, and Soul Siphon adds 12% to it for each of the three on the target.
Shadow Bolt with every DoT up, until Wrack at 40 takes over as your filler.
Shoot only when you are out of mana and cannot Life Tap. A wand shot cannot start during a global cooldown, so it never fits between spells.
